si3_author_journal_year: Sun et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2025
si4_title: Dissecting heterogeneity in major depressive disorder via normative model-driven subtyping of functional brain networks

dc1_datasets_used.detail: Data were obtained from the REST-meta-MDD project provided by the DIRECT consortium.
dc1_datasets_used.supporting_text: "These data were obtained from a publicly accessible dataset from the REST-meta-MDD project (Yan et al., 2019) provided by the DIRECT consortium (Chen et al., 2022)."
dc1_datasets_used.location: Sun2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Participants, Paragraph 1

dc2_dataset_purpose.detail: 822 HCs from REST-meta-MDD were used to train the normative models. 797 MDD patients from the same dataset were used to calculate deviations and identify subtypes.
dc2_dataset_purpose.supporting_text: "Utilizing rs-fMRI data from a cohort of 797 MDD patients and 822 matched healthy controls (HC)... Utilizing normative modeling of HC... we quantified individual deviations in brain network degree centrality among MDD patients."

dc3_hc_n.detail: The study used 822 HCs. Normative models were trained on all HC data and applied to MDD patients.
dc3_hc_n.supporting_text: "The sample data were derived from 1619 participants, encompassing 797 individuals diagnosed with MDD... and 822 healthy controls (HC...)" ... "Then, the normative models were trained on all HC data and later applied to MDD patients."
dc3_hc_n.location: Sun2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Participants, Paragraph 1; Materials and methods / Capturing individual deviations from normative models, Paragraph 1

dc4_hc_age.detail: HC mean age 35.045 +/- 13.336. Exclusion criteria: age < 18 or > 65.
